items.description: The Oued Nfiss is a river in the High Atlas Mountains, known for its scenic gorges and contributing to local irrigation.
The Oued Tensift estuary near Essaouira is a vital wetland and a stopover point for migratory birds.
Cap Spartel is a prominent cape near Tangier, marking the meeting point of the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea.
The Oued Noun Valley is a distinctive geographical feature in southern Morocco, characterized by its arid riverbed and date palms.
The Figuig Oasis is a collection of seven oases near the Algerian border, renowned for its ancient kasbahs and date groves.
The hills of Moulay Idriss surround the sacred town, offering a picturesque and fertile landscape in the Zerhoun region.
The Oued Tensift Valley is a significant agricultural area in the Marrakech plains, fed by the river's irrigation system.
The High Plateaus are an expansive, semi-arid elevated region in eastern Morocco, used primarily for pastoralism.
